evidence.claim: Etsy says it collects and uses information to provide and improve its Services, protect their security and integrity, and comply with legal obligations.
Etsy says it works with third-party advertising and marketing partners for interest-based advertising and links to more information and choices.
Etsy says it engages third-party companies such as research companies, analytics services and security providers to help operate, provide and advertise the Services.
Etsy says it engages third-party service providers who facilitate sharing of data between similar companies, such as retail companies, for purposes like fraud prevention and security.
Buyers and sellers can choose to make certain information and activities private through account or public profile settings; Etsy links to interest-based advertising choices.
Etsy says it retains information only as long as necessary for its stated purposes, while the account is active, or as needed for legal obligations, internal policies or law.

Etsy says it works with third-party advertising and marketing partners for interest-based advertising and engages analytics and other service providers, and lets users make some information private in settings.

Exodus Privacy static analysis of version 7.96.0 (report dated Sept. 21, 2026) found code signatures for 10 known tracker SDK(s): AppsFlyer (analytics), Branch (analytics), Facebook Analytics (analytics), Facebook Login (identification), Facebook Share, fullstory (analytics), Google AdMob (advertisement), Google Firebase Analytics (analytics), Qualtrics, Sentry (crash reporting). A signature shows the SDK is present, not what data it sends.
